name: IME Player Name (Manual)
description: Request §88-90 (D30): what an automated client cannot judge. The run stops at each manual check; a person answers PASS / FAIL in the web UI (or p/f on a terminal). In CI (no terminal) the checks are SKIPPED and the run continues (--manual fail turns them into failures).

steps.description: Title screen: type a Korean name (테스트) in the name field with the IME. While composing, the syllable shows in the field (not in a separate box at the screen corner).
Press Enter / Connect: the committed name is exactly 테스트 (no leftover jamo, no doubled last syllable), and it shows on the kill feed / result screen.
